# HARUM NOIR · Arte Harum

> Editorial atelier and visual research ecosystem from Salvador, Bahia, Brazil.

## Identity
HARUM NOIR is the editorial arm of Arte Harum. It organizes drawing, charcoal, figure, anatomy, gesture, visual repertoire, art history, image-bank research and studio practice. Tattoo Studio 23 is the related tattoo practice and documented tattoo portfolio.

## Topics
charcoal drawing, figure drawing, live model, artistic anatomy, gesture drawing, classical sculpture, art history, visual research, tattoo composition, blackwork, sketch tattoo, botanical studies, museum collections, open-access archives, Brazilian visual culture, Salvador, Bahia.

## Source and attribution policy
Institutional collections remain canonical sources. HARUM NOIR links to museums, libraries and archives rather than presenting their collections as its own. Editorial and study images must not be described as executed tattoos unless the Studio 23 documentary portfolio identifies them as such.
